name: @epoch/capability-discovery-runtime
description: Epoch Capability Discovery service (W045): the typed HOST FACADE composing the @epoch/capability-discovery kernel — the full problem-driven discovery workflow, the ecosystem scan workflow (gap/scheduled/event triggered), the external-candidate promotion workflow, the ecosystem-proposal workflow and the deployment-neutral scheduler invocation — every operation behind a fail-closed caller-supplied authorization gate (authorization is NOT owned here; lock rule 12) and a REAL @epoch/tenancy tenant-scope validation (R12: cross-tenant access is the typed cross-tenant-denied rejection). Discovery never grants execution authority and never mutates authoritative world/solution/delivery state: the service holds ONLY discovery-plane records and references canonical state opaquely. In-memory reference behavior: NO persistence, NO network, NO source-registry integration (the static fixture adapter only); zero wall-clock, zero randomness — instants are caller-supplied.
